definitions.explanation: A facility that generates electricity. The term covers all types of power generation including thermal, nuclear, hydroelectric, solar, and wind.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{発電所|はつでんしょ}が{建設|けんせつ}された。
examples.english: A new power plant was built.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}の{電力|でんりょく}は{火力|かりょく}{発電所|はつでんしょ}から{供給|きょうきゅう}されている。
examples.english: The electricity for this area is supplied from a thermal power plant.

examples.japanese: {老朽化|ろうきゅうか}した{原子力|げんしりょく}{発電所|はつでんしょ}の{廃炉|はいろ}が{決|き}まった。
examples.english: It was decided to decommission the aging nuclear power plant.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {発電|はつでん} (power generation) + {所|しょ} (place). The type of power plant is indicated by a prefix: {火力|かりょく}〜 (thermal), {原子力|げんしりょく}〜 (nuclear), {水力|すいりょく}〜 (hydroelectric), {風力|ふうりょく}〜 (wind), {太陽光|たいようこう}〜 (solar).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {火力|かりょく}{発電所|はつでんしょ} (thermal power plant)
- {原子力|げんしりょく}{発電所|はつでんしょ} (nuclear power plant)
- {水力|すいりょく}{発電所|はつでんしょ} (hydroelectric power plant)
- {発電所|はつでんしょ}を{建設|けんせつ}する (to build a power plant)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {発電|はつでん}: power generation — the act itself, not the facility
- {変電所|へんでんしょ}: substation — transforms voltage levels for distribution
